lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; primary nodes are arranged in approximately 8-10 identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with higher spot density observed in the dorsal-anterior quadrant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~5-8 pixels in width) that align with and intersect the vertical columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernable grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (upper-edge highlights and lower-edge shadows) extending longitudinally across the upper two-thirds of the visible flank.
